content: The Mathlib Initiative is preparing for launch and building our team! We're hiring Mathematical Research Engineers (part-time contractor, perfect for current Mathlib contributors) and a DevOps Engineer (full-time) to help scale the infrastructure that supports the entire formal mathematics ecosystem. Both roles work closely with existing maintainers and the broader community to amplify volunteer efforts. Applications due September 14. Questions: johan@renphil.org

The Mathlib Initiative has just opened a role for a Lean Metaprogrammer. It is full-time and fully remote.

This is an opportunity to have a significant and enduring impact on Mathlib. Further details are available at the job listing (linked above). Informal inquiries may be made to <hiring@mathlib-initiative.org>.

Oliver Nash said:

It is full-time and fully remote.

Just pointing out that the application form says the following:

Note: Renaissance Philanthropy operates as a hybrid, geo-flexible organization. We do prefer folks who are in-office in New York, D.C., London, or Tokyo 2-3 days a week or able to travel to one of these locations once a month.

I am still 100% applying for this job from Australia anyway! Will see what happens :)

Thanks I'll get this adjusted next week. That text is intended to apply for people who join the RenPhil core team rather than one of its programmes, like the Mathlib Initiative. Everyone at the MI is fully remote and we have almost no restrictions on location.
